newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean auto makers post big export rise in Nov.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean auto makers post big export rise in Nov.

text.p: South Korea's five auto makers on Monday reported sharp export jumps in November of between 30 percent and 145 percent from a year earlier.
Hyundai Motor Co Ltd, the country's largest vehicle maker, said it exported 61,000 units in the month, up 34 percent from a year before.
Kia Motors Corp said its exports for November totalled 34,000 units, up 70 percent, while Daewoo Motor Co Ltd reported a 145 percent export rise to 55,300 units.
Ssangyong Motor Co Ltd, a producer of four wheel-drive utility vehicles and mini buses, said its vehicle shipments were 2,460 units in November, up 30 percent from a year ago.
Asia Motors said its exports doubled to 2,630 units in the month.
